name: folio-paged-box-decoration-break-for-height-a4fc
instr:
Folio cannot apply CSS box-decoration-break slice or clone behavior to height-aware Div, Flex, and Grid containers across page fragments. Carry fragment decoration through layout, pagination, HTML conversion, and PDF emission without changing default output.

`NewDiv`, `NewFlex`, and `NewGrid` must return pointer containers satisfying `HeightSettable`. Valid decoration modes must survive temporary forced-height planning. `FragmentDecorationSlice` exposes both inline edges everywhere, the leading edge on unsplit and first fragments, and the trailing edge on unsplit and last fragments. `FragmentDecorationClone` exposes every edge at every `FragmentPosition`. Unsupported modes return `ErrInvalidFragmentDecoration` with exact text `invalid fragment decoration mode` without changing receiver state.

`(*Div).SetFragmentDecoration`, `(*Flex).SetFragmentDecoration`, and `(*Grid).SetFragmentDecoration` must preserve overflow, sizing, placement, and single-draw behavior. Advance continuation position only when an accepted `LayoutPartial` has real overflow. Retries, failures, and cancellation leave reusable state unchanged. Emit settled geometry without changing pagination or drawing children twice. Cascade and inherit `box-decoration-break` into converted block, flex, and grid containers, handling invalid declarations like existing CSS. Without a selected mode, preserve existing pagination and PDF bytes for Go and HTML use.

For sliced Div, remove the leading edge only after accepting
